Hi Aisha — great to meet you (virtually). Thanks for kicking this off. Below is a concise inbound checklist and the PO/invoice rules so you can line things up on your end. I've copied Laura (Procurement Ops) to complete the vendor record once you return the docs.

What we need from you (please bundle where possible):
- Completed Redwood vendor onboarding template (see attached)
- Current W-9 (PDF)
- Remittance address + billing contact (email + phone)
- Certificate of insurance if invoice amount > $50k or if specified in contract
- Banking details for ACH (optional; if you prefer wire, indicate wire instructions)
- Tax / VAT registration documents if invoicing from outside US

What Redwood will provide / what you should expect from us:
- Our vendor ID and primary Redwood billing email: ap-invoices@redwood.ai
- PO format: Redwood PO numbers are PO-YYYY-NNNNN (example: PO-2027-05432). Please include that exact PO number on the invoice header and in the PDF metadata.
- Invoicing cadence: Net 30 standard unless otherwise negotiated in the SOW
- Preferred invoice submission: invoices@redwood.ai; cc ap-invoices@redwood.ai for faster routing
- Required invoice fields: Redwood vendor ID, PO number, invoice date, invoice number, line-item description, tax breakdown, total due, remittance address (if different)

Attached is our vendor onboarding template to save you time. Once you return the bundle, Laura will confirm vendor ID and we can issue the initial PO. If there are any special tax forms, flag them in your submission and we'll route to tax.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Partnerships | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: vendor_onboarding_template.xlsx]
